subject: As in the start frame: the strap stays on the front of the knee every frame.

camera.movement: Virtual camera already pushing in very slowly on frame one, no orbit, mechanically smooth. Still moving at the cut.

motion: Already cycling on the very first frame, product seated and working, walking cadence, one arrival per second. On each arrival the knee joint flexes, quadriceps, hamstrings and calf shortens and releases, and the rigid element meets the load first — settling a fraction deeper into the tissue and holding that indentation while the load is present, the black elastic band in a coarse knit with a visible textured weave and straight edges band visibly stretching open along the line of force and easing back between. Beneath it the patellar tendon barely moves and does not light: the sensation that fired at the patellar tendon immediately below the patella on every load simply does not arrive, arrival after arrival, and the patellar tendon immediately below the patella stays cool and pale for the whole clip. The product holds station under every arrival — never sliding, never rotating, never riding up. Still cycling at the cut, load still landing, the patellar tendon immediately below the patella still quiet.
